search_lane: Independently search all five interests in Chinese and English, including less visible new teams, Chinese financing, drones, space computing and edge models. No fixed company list. Record actual searches, failures and gaps.
rules: Use the frozen issue window from prepare; the date of a digest is not the event or original publication date.
An entry page or RSS item is a discovery lead. Fetch the relevant article or issue, then trace selected events to original evidence.
Try a different entry or scoped search when an entry fails; preserve failure evidence instead of repeatedly fetching the same address.
Multiple reposts of one announcement or interview are one evidence lineage.
Expand beyond these entry points when the day's events justify it; no source quotas or company quotas.
